events.factual_description: The Metropolitan Museum of Art presents Chief Xian aTunde Adjuah: Sound Carved from Legend on Monday, February 8 and Tuesday, February 9, 2027 at 7:00 PM in Gallery 131, the Temple of Dendur. The Met describes the performance as the premiere of a brand-new work written especially for the Temple of Dendur and, in its 2026-27 season announcement, calls it a newly commissioned project exploring Black, Brown, and Maroon histories in the United States as part of the museum's Black History Month programming. Tickets start at $70; the season announcement lists a $70 ticket price. The verified Met materials do not identify additional live personnel or a detailed instrumentation/repertoire list, so none is inferred here.

en.why_it_matters: This is the kind of commission where the room is part of the composition. Adjuah is premiering new music written specifically for the Temple of Dendur, using the Met's monumental Egyptian space to frame a work about Black, Brown, and Maroon histories in the United States. The attraction is not simply hearing a formidable improviser in a prestigious museum; it is hearing a new piece whose historical argument and physical setting were conceived together.
en.trip_verdict: From the DMV, I would make New York the plan around one of these two nights rather than assume the same work-space encounter will surface later on tour. Choose February 8 or 9 early, then build the rest of the trip around the Met.
en.listen_before: No direct prerequisite is published for the new commission; use Adjuah's recent work as orientation rather than a promised set list.

es.why_it_matters: Ésta es una de esas comisiones en las que la sala forma parte de la obra. Adjuah estrenará música nueva escrita específicamente para el Templo de Dendur, usando el espacio monumental egipcio del Met para enmarcar una pieza sobre historias negras, brown y cimarronas en Estados Unidos. El atractivo no es simplemente escuchar a un improvisador formidable dentro de un museo prestigioso: es oír una obra nueva cuyo argumento histórico y espacio físico fueron concebidos juntos.
es.trip_verdict: Desde el DMV, sí haría de Nueva York el plan alrededor de una de estas dos noches, en vez de asumir que el mismo encuentro entre obra y espacio aparecerá después en una gira. Escogería pronto el 8 o el 9 de febrero y construiría el resto del viaje alrededor del Met.
es.listen_before: No hay una escucha previa directa publicada para la nueva comisión; usaría la obra reciente de Adjuah como orientación, no como promesa de repertorio.
